QuestInfo.name: Wounded Tree, Wounded Heart
QuestInfo.0: The bugs are gone, but there's a new problem. Talk to #bSugar#k.
QuestInfo.1: Sugar is saddened about the chunk of the tree that the bugs ate. Find #bSabitrama#k in #bSleepywood#k to see if anything can be done.

0.0: Oh no... Oh no, oh no, oh no...\r\n#L0##bWhat's wrong?#l\n#k
0.1: This tree... The bugs carved out a chunk of its trunk. It's in so much pain! It's... It's weeping!\r\n#L0##b(What is she talking about? Trees don't cry!)#l\n#k
0.2: We need to get this tree some #bmedicine#k right away! There's a medicine man in #bSleepywood#k named Sabitrama. Please, can you see if he can help? \r\n#L0##b(The girl's eyes are filling with tears. Guess you have no choice.)#l\n#k

yes.0: Hurry! I'll stay here and comfort the tree as best as I can.

no.0: But the tree is in so much pain!

1.0: A stranger walks into the great #bSabitrama's#k presence. Peace! What brings you to me, friend? No, don't say a word. I already know...

npc.0: Take the hidden path by the tree stump at the center of the Six Path Crossway to get to Sleepywood and find #bSabitrama#k. Hurry!
